name: Route du Rhum 2026 — Virtual
description: Virtual edition of the 13th Route du Rhum — Destination Guadeloupe: solo transat, Saint-Malo to Pointe-à-Pitre, ~3,542 nm. Start 12:02 UTC (13:02 local) Sun 1 Nov 2026 with the real gun. Course: past Cap Fréhel, clear Ushant, then across the Atlantic to round Guadeloupe the classic way — leave the Tête à l'Anglais at the north of Basse-Terre to port, run the leeward west coast, round Vieux-Fort at the south and beat back up to the finish off Pointe-à-Pitre. Trade-wind route vs. great circle is the whole game. Polar: Class40 (meltemus.com) at 90% — the Rhum's Ultims and IMOCAs will be quicker; everyone sails the same numbers.
